thread:
josh: Hey team — starting onboarding for new asia-east2 GPU cluster. Need capacity earmark for 48 x A100s for 3-week bring-up. Can we confirm quota window and any IP/VPC constraints? :wave:
ana: Thanks. Two quick Qs: 1) Are these reserved forever or temporary for the bring-up? 2) Which zones in asia-east2? We need pod affinity planning.
josh: Temporary reservation: reservation window 2026-04-05 -> 2026-04-26. Zones: asia-east2-a/b. We'll scale to 48 total across both.
linh: Noted. I'll open a quota case with cloud provider today. Will request per-zone GPU quota + additional ephemeral NICs. Draft MR for quota request in #infra-requests in 10m.
josh: thx. Please include estimated sustained vCPU / memory for the supporting control plane (k8s nodes) — ops will need that for subnet sizing.
linh: ACK. Initial ask: 48 GPUs, 400 vCPU, 2.5TB RAM, 150 ephemeral IPs. Using naming: rwd-asia2-bringup-2026
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New reservation ticket created: TKT-8421 — link: https://tickets.internal/TKT-8421
ana: Also consider tenant isolation: Dedicated pools for staging vs prod bring-up? If prod testing runs, we should allocate separate nodepools and not mix.
josh: We'll do two nodepools: bringup-prod (32 GPUs) + bringup-staging (16 GPUs). Keeping them isolated.
maria: FYI cost estimate ~ $0.95/hr/GPU for A100-80GB in that region — rough calc: 48 * 0.95 * 24 * 21 ≈ $22k for the window. Approve?
ops-oncall: Approving oncall budget for temporary reservation. Please attach PO after line itemization. I'll add a runbook stub to oncall checklist.
josh: Attached minimal runbook snippet for handoff:

```
- Prechecks (before capacity live):
  - Quota confirmed + provider ACK (ticket #)
  - VPC + subnets created (CIDRs: 10.40.0.0/16)
  - K8s control plane sizing validated
  - IAM roles for node bootstrap created
- Bring-up day (D0):
  - Create nodepools with taints: reserved=bringup
  - Apply network policies, validate cross-zone MTU
  - Smoke test with small perf job (1 GPU, 2k tokens)
- Handoff (D+3):
  - Transfer runbook to SRE oncall
  - Confirm autoscaler policies and cost alarms
```

linh: Good. For the quota request body I'm using:

```
subject: Request: Temporary GPU quota increase for asia-east2
body:
- project: redwood-prod
- reason: region bring-up for inference cluster
- resources: GPUs: 48 (A100), vCPU: 400, RAM: 2500GB, ExternalIPs: 150
- window: 2026-04-05 to 2026-04-26
- contact: linh@redwood.com, josh@redwood.com
```

ana: Add note to include fallback model routing in case only partial capacity is granted. We should predefine smaller variants and a routing policy.
josh: will add. Also, please schedule capacity validation run one day after live: run 4 x 1-hour perf jobs across pods to validate latency SLOs.
maria: I'll include cost center tags: billing:eng-infra, project_tag: rwd-asia2-bringup
ops-oncall: Once quota OK, ping me and I'll create the temporary PagerDuty escalation for the window.
linh: Opening provider case now and pinging vendor rep. Expect provider ACK in ~48hrs. I'll update this thread with ticket link + PO draft once vendor confirms.
josh: perfect. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
